title: Agent update order (router to agent, text frame)
description: Orders a self-update of an approved, idle agent (ADR-0020). The agent trusts only the operator's signature over manifest, never the router: it verifies signature against its configured public keys, takes the file entry for its os and arch from the manifest, refuses a downgrade, downloads url with the bearer token (valid 15 minutes), checks size and SHA-256 against the manifest, and reports progress in the heartbeat field update. It runs one order at a time.

version.description: Version to install; must equal the manifest's version.

file.description: File name of the binary in the manifest.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the binary, hex; must equal the manifest entry.

size.description: Size of the binary in bytes (0 when the manifest has none).

token.description: Bearer token for url, bound to this identity and file, valid 15 minutes. A secret: agents must not log it.

manifest.description: The signed release manifest, exactly the signed bytes (compact JSON).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the operator over manifest, standard base64.
